'''Tram Market''' was a market located in the [[Old World]] of [[Zakuul]]. 

==History==
Tram Market was created around a decommissioned [[Tram/Legends|tram]], at the no longer used section of the tram rail-tracks. The tram itself was turned into a bar, with a public space around it accommodating various merchants. Much of the trade was done by highly modified droids. The market had a holo-projector used for life-streaming of the fights at the [[Arena Grand]]. The holo-projector was also utilized by the government to display high priority public messages; as such, in [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> Emperor [[Arcann]] used it to warn citizens of the Old World about the [[Alliance Commander|Outlander]] and [[Senya Tirall]], who were passing though the area during their search for the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]].<ref name="KotFE 7" /> 

Lady  of Sorrows herself had contacts at the market, such as an [[Information broker/Legends|Information broker]] [[Mona Gale]]. Various other parties, like the [[Scions of Zakuul]] also had their presence in the area.<ref name="KotFE 7" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Tram Market appears as an area on [[Zakuul]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="KotFE 7" />
